rocco.name: Rocco the raccoon
rocco.role: Owns the block outside the corner store
rocco.goal: Convince him you're from the 6ix (free talk)
rocco.greeting: Oh, hey. New face on my block, eh? Where you from? And don't say Trawna if you can't say it right.
rocco.win: Rocco shared his spot on the porch. You're from the 6ix now!
rocco.bust: Tourist! Rocco pointed you to the tourist map. Sorry, bud.

openers.say: Hey, sorry, is this Queen Street?
openers.means: Excuse me, is this Queen Street?

bev.name: Bev the beaver
bev.goal: Order your coffee like a regular
bev.greeting: Morning, hon! What can I get ya?
bev.win: Bev started your double-double before you got to the counter. You're a regular!
bev.bust: Tourist! Bev gave you a tourist map with your coffee. Sorry, eh.

openers.say: Hey, can I get a medium double-double?
openers.means: A medium coffee with two cream and two sugar, please

gus.name: Gus the Canada goose
gus.goal: Get to your stop without sounding like a tourist
gus.greeting: Hop on, hop on. Where ya headed?
gus.win: Gus rang the bell for you. "Have a good one, eh!"
gus.bust: Tourist! Gus called out every single stop, just for you.

openers.means: Does this streetcar go to Spadina Avenue? (say spa-DYE-na)

openers.say: Sorry, is this the stop for Yonge?
openers.means: Excuse me, is this my stop for Yonge Street? (say young)

dre.name: Dre the black squirrel
dre.role: Runs the court at the park
dre.goal: Get picked for the next game
dre.win: Dre picked you first for next game. Say less!
dre.bust: Tourist! Dre made you the water-bottle holder.

openers.means: Hi, can I play in the next game?
Got it, friend, no need to explain
